question.text: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>B</mi><mi>X</mi></msub></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>B</mi><mi>Y</mi></msub></math> are the magnetic field at the centre of two coils of two coils <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>X</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Y</mi></math> respectively, each carrying equal current. If coil <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>X</mi></math> has <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>200</mn></math> turns and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>20</mn><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math> radius and coil <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Y</mi></math> has <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>400</mn></math> turns and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>20</mn><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math> radius, the ratio of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>B</mi><mi>X</mi></msub></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>B</mi><mi>Y</mi></msub></math> is

solution.text:
Magnetic field at the centre of a single coil is B=μ0i2R

If N number of loops are kept closely B=Nμ0i2R

Therefore,

BxBy=NxNy

⇒BxBy=12
